title: Before Smartphones

pre.en: How does the grandmother feel about life before smartphones?
pre.zh: 奶奶怎么看没有智能手机的那些年？
options: She can't remember much about it.
She thinks it was better for families.
She doesn't miss it at all.

intro: 一篇人物小传：「我」在视频里请七十五岁的奶奶讲讲没有智能手机的年代。读的时候留意 used to：它说的是过去常常这样、现在已经不这样的习惯和状态；和它对照，说现在的情况用一般现在时。奶奶对那个年代到底是什么态度？读到最后一段再下结论。

sentences.en: My grandma's seventy-five, and we have a video call every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶七十五了，我们每个星期天都视频。

sentences.en: She always starts with the same question: "Are you eating enough?"
sentences.zh: 她一开口总是那句：「有没有好好吃饭？」

sentences.en: Last Sunday, for a change, I asked the questions.
sentences.zh: 上周日换了个样，轮到我来问她了。

sentences.en: "Grandma, what was life like before smartphones?"
sentences.zh: 「奶奶，没有智能手机那会儿，日子是怎么过的？」

sentences.en: "Well," she said, "I used to know twenty phone numbers by heart.
sentences.zh: 「嗯，」她说，「那时候我能背出二十个电话号码。

sentences.en: We didn't use to have a phone at home, so I used the one on the counter at the post office.
sentences.zh: 家里没电话，要打电话就去邮局，用柜台上那部。

sentences.en: There was always a queue, and if the line was engaged, you had to call back later."
sentences.zh: 那儿老排着队，要是占线，就只能过会儿再打。」

sentences.en: Her sister lived in Shanghai, and back then, letters were the cheapest way to keep in touch.
sentences.zh: 她妹妹住在上海，那时候写信是姐妹俩保持联系最省钱的办法。

sentences.en: "I used to look forward to the post every morning," she told me.
sentences.zh: 「那时候我每天早上都盼着来信，」她跟我说。

sentences.en: "Sometimes I waited for ages for one envelope with her handwriting on it."
sentences.zh: 「有时候等上好久，才等来一封她亲笔写的信。」

sentences.en: She still keeps all those letters in an old biscuit tin.
sentences.zh: 那些信她到现在还收在一个旧饼干铁盒里。

sentences.en: She didn't use to take many photos, either.
sentences.zh: 那时候她也不怎么拍照。

sentences.en: "Film was expensive," she said, "and it took two weeks to get your pictures back."
sentences.zh: 「胶卷贵啊，」她说，「而且洗一次照片得等两个星期。」

sentences.en: Eight years ago, my cousin gave her a smartphone.
sentences.zh: 八年前，表姐送了她一部智能手机。

sentences.en: It took her a whole year to get used to it.
sentences.zh: 她花了整整一年才用顺手。

sentences.en: In the end, she learned to send voice messages — dozens a day.
sentences.zh: 后来她学会了发语音——一天几十条。

sentences.en: I thought she probably missed the old days.
sentences.zh: 我以为她多半挺怀念从前的。

sentences.en: "Miss them? Not at all!" she laughed.
sentences.zh: 「怀念？才不呢！」她笑着说。

sentences.en: "These days I'm in three group chats, and I can't help checking them.
sentences.zh: 「我现在加了三个群，老忍不住要点开看。

sentences.en: Anyway, I've got to go.
sentences.zh: 好了，不聊了。

sentences.en: My online yoga class is starting."
sentences.zh: 我的网上瑜伽课要开始了。」

cards.note: in order to do something different from what you usually do
from memory, without needing to read it
cards.tip: 常和 know、learn 连用：know sth by heart 背得出，learn sth by heart 把……背下来。
cards.example: After a year on the project, I know the release checklist by heart.

cards.note: to phone someone again, or to phone someone who called you earlier
to continue to talk or write to someone
cards.tip: 跟谁保持联系用 with：keep in touch with old colleagues；告别时常说 Let's keep in touch!；get in touch 是「联系上」，是一次性的动作。
cards.example: We still keep in touch, even though she left the company last year.

cards.note: to feel happy about something that is going to happen
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 -ing：look forward to seeing you，不说 look forward to see you。
cards.example: I'm really looking forward to the team dinner on Friday.

cards.note: 英式说 the post，指每天送来的信件，也指邮政：send it by post；美式多说 the mail。

cards.tip: 口语说法，正式场合用 for a long time；也常说 take ages：The download took ages.
cards.example: I waited for ages for the build to finish.

cards.note: 重音在第一个音节：/ˈenvələʊp/；寄信时信封上要贴 stamp（邮票）。
不可数名词：Her handwriting is beautiful.；by hand 是「手写地」。
英式说法：a biscuit tin 饼干盒，a tin of beans 一罐豆子；美式多说 can。
常见意思是「电影」；这里指老式相机用的胶卷，作不可数名词。
to become familiar with something new so that it no longer feels strange
cards.tip: 别和本课的 used to 混：used to + 动词原形是「过去常常」；get used to + 名词 / doing 是「渐渐习惯」。
cards.example: It took me a few weeks to get used to the new keyboard.

cards.note: after a long time, or after a lot of problems
a dozen 是「一打、十二个」；dozens of … 泛指「几十个、好多」：dozens of emails。

cards.tip: 和 in those days（那时候）相对；后面常用一般现在时或现在进行时。
cards.example: These days most of our meetings are online.

cards.note: to be unable to stop yourself doing something
cards.tip: 这里的 help 是「忍住」，不是「帮助」；后面接 -ing：can't help laughing，不说 can't help to laugh。过去式是 couldn't help doing。
cards.example: I can't help checking my work email at the weekend.

cards.note: 读 /ˈjəʊɡə/；do yoga 练瑜伽，a yoga class 一节瑜伽课。
